title: Usa un video simple de pelea como referencia para que Seedance 2.0 conserve la…
content:
Usa un video simple de pelea como referencia para que Seedance 2.0 conserve la acción, el ritmo y los movimientos de cámara y los transforme en una escena nueva (p. ej., batalla de mechas) sin animación manual.  
Sube un video de combate con espadas como referencia para mantener la coreografía original y convertirla en un duelo futurista (p. ej., espadas de energía) con transferencia de movimiento precisa.  
En Dreamina, entra en AI Video y selecciona Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 para trabajar con referencias.  
Sube materiales de referencia (imágenes, videos, audio o texto) hasta 12 archivos para guiar la generación.  
Usa @ en el prompt para indicar cómo debe utilizarse cada material de referencia.  
Describe explícitamente en el prompt la escena, el estilo y el movimiento que quieres generar antes de hacer clic en Generar.

Use a simple fight video as a reference for Seedance 2.0 to retain the action, rhythm, and camera movements and transform them into a new scene (e.g., mecha battle) without manual animation.  
Upload a sword combat video as a reference to maintain the original choreography and convert it into a futuristic duel (e.g., energy swords) with precise motion transfer.  
In Dreamina, enter AI Video and select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0 to work with references.  
Upload reference materials (images, videos, audio, or text) up to 12 files to guide the generation.  
Use @ in the prompt to indicate how each reference material should be used.  
Explicitly describe in the prompt the scene, style, and movement you want to generate before clicking Generate.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] For this example, I used a simple fight scene as a reference.
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 retained the action, rhythm, and camera movements, and transformed them into an epic mecha battle with cinematic quality.
No manual animation. Just reference + generation. 🤯

[Thread 2] For this example, I used a simple sword combat video as a reference.
Dreamina Seedance 2.0 retained the original choreography and transformed it into a futuristic duel with energy swords.
The motion transfer is incredibly precise. https://t.co/gvy0sWEYmf

[Thread 3] Want to try it yourself?
Here's how I did it:
1. Open Dreamina 👉 https://t.co/UgBCtVlJKB
2. Enter AI Video and select Omni Reference + Dreamina Seedance 2.0
3. Upload your reference materials (images, videos, audio, or text; up to 12 files)
4. Use @ in the prompt to indicate how each material should be used
5. Write the scene, style, and movement you want to generate
6. Click Generate and let Seedance 2.0 do the rest
The best part is that it can retain the movements and visual narrative of your references while transforming them into completely new scenes.
